stem:
Hexane, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{14}$, is a colourless liquid.
Two test-tubes contain equal amounts of hexane. $1\text{ cm}^3$ of bromine, $\text{Br}_2\text{(aq)}$, is added to both test-tubes. One test-tube is kept in the dark and the other is exposed to sunlight.

The table describes the appearance of each test-tube after one hour.

| test-tube conditions | observations |
| :--- | :--- |
| in the dark | no change, mixture remains orange |
| in sunlight | colour of mixture fades to pale yellow |

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The test-tube in the dark is kept cool and is not exposed to ultraviolet light.

Explain the observations for the test-tube kept in the dark.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: In sunlight, bromine reacts with hexane by a mechanism which occurs via a series of steps.
parts.text: State the name of the mechanism of the reaction that occurs.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Give an equation which shows a propagation step in this reaction in which hexane produces $\cdot\text{C}_6\text{H}_{13}$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Give an equation which shows a propagation step in this reaction that produces 1-bromohexane.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Give an equation which shows a termination step in this reaction that produces 1-bromohexane.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
**A** and **B** are different straight chain alkenes with molecular formula, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{12}$.

**A** does not show stereoisomerism.

**A** reacts with potassium manganate(VII) to form hexane-1,2-diol.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: State the conditions needed for this reaction of **A**.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem: **B** reacts with hydrogen gas in the presence of a platinum catalyst to produce hexane.
parts.text: Name the type of reaction occurring.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: In terms of $\sigma$ and $\pi$ bonds, describe any similarities and differences in the type of carbon-carbon bonds in **B** and the type of carbon-carbon bonds in hexane.
